senses.gloss:
táthā, adv.
 —1. so, thus, 11^4, 24^16; in
this way, 99^20; w. yathā, yathā regularly
preceding: yathā…tathā: as…so, 21^16,
61^6, 77^13; in order that…thus, 30^16, 37^7;
but tathā…yathā, so…as, 22^13, 43^20;
yathā yathā…tathā tathā, to what
degree…to that degree, the more…
the more, 48^14; yathā tathā, in one way
or another, 62^9;
 —2. particle of assent, so
be it, yes, 4^2, 8^6, 48^12, 94^5; that is so, 52^16;
[]
 —3. so, in like manner, 19^8; or, simply
conjunctive, also, likewise, 10^8, 12^13, etc.;
tathā_eva, just so (cf. Middle Eng. al so,
i. e.), likewise, also, 1^11, 7^10; tathā ca, 18^20,
see ca 3;
 —4. tathā_api, so even, even
under those circumstances, nevertheless,
21^11. [pron. root ta, 497, 1101.]

táthā-vidha, a. of such sort, in such
condition. [tathā (1306) + vidhā, 1302c 5.]
